_README: Calibration tables harvested from the original adcp.ucsd.edu portal by tools/harvest_calibrations.py. A cruise row is {cells, year, cruise, kind}: cells match columns[] and are verbatim from the source, shorthand and all (see legend[]); year drives the year filter; cruise is the portal cruise id the row refers to, or null where the portal does not publish it; kind is 'note' for a row recording a refit or a cancelled cruise rather than a processed one.
